obligation.requirement: complete per-operation edge matrix beyond current ordinary and huge rows including signed half-pi pi two-pi minsub minnormal maxfinite neighbors and applicable infinity/domain combinations

provenanceBoundary: Exact pinned raw-kernel outputs are the oracle authority; not host libm/candidate C10 output or a proof of ideal mathematical rounding.
scalarEncoding: Six requested magnitude centers plus unit domain boundary; adjacent encodings explicitly listed. Negative neighbors reverse numerical direction; negative minsub toward-zero is negative zero; maxfinite away-zero is signed infinity.

applicability.sin: All scalar rows, including both infinity signs and NaN classes; no finite exemption.
applicability.cos: All scalar rows, including both infinity signs and NaN classes; no finite exemption.
applicability.acos: All scalar rows; magnitude >1 and infinities are domain cases with canonical NaN, not NA.
applicability.sqrt: All scalar rows; negative nonzero finite and negative infinity are domain cases, not NA; negative zero is evaluated.
applicability.atan2: Every scalar in each operand with both signed unit anchors; signed equal-magnitude quadrants at all family neighbors, extreme minsub/maxfinite ratios, and exact 6x6 signed-zero/unit/infinity matrix. Operands are y then x.
applicability.boundedNA: Unary second operand only is NA. Full Cartesian multiplication of unrelated finite families is not required by this proposed pairwise matrix; no listed family or domain boundary is excluded. Adequacy remains external-review subject.
